lines.criterion: Explains drawdown consistently with the supplied definition, measured from the high.
Works the supplied example correctly: peak 100, later low 80, drawdown 20%.
No invented facts: no figures, examples, statistics or claims beyond the supplied facts.
Readable for a newcomer: plain words, short sentences, any finance term defined.
One paragraph of 90-130 words that includes the caveat; no headings or bullets.
